decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies through counterspells and removal spells while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. It also uses powerful threats like Crackling Drake to close out the game. The deck is designed to control the board and tempo of the game, allowing the player to dictate the flow of the match and come out on top through efficient spells and impactful creatures. It aims to outvalue opponents by efficiently trading resources and maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo of Lotus Field and Thespian's Stage to generate a large amount of mana quickly. Using cards like Hidden Strings, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Pore Over the Pages to untap Lotus Field and produce even more mana. The aim is to ramp up to powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck also includes cards for card selection and recursion, ensuring consistency and resilience against disruption.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Censor, Dovin's Veto, and Supreme Verdict while generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes win conditions such as The Wandering Emperor and March of Otherworldly Light. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy with lands like Hallowed Fountain, Glacial Fortress, and Field of Ruin.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost creatures, utilizing the Aggro strategy. By playing creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant alongside support cards like Brave the Elements and Mutavault, the deck aims to flood the board with Weenie White creatures and push for damage early in the game. Cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard provide additional power and resilience to the deck, allowing it to maintain pressure and close out the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks. It includes efficient card draw, cheap removal spells, and mana spells to power out Phoenixes quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and keeping pressure on the opponent to deal with the recurring threat of Arclight Phoenix. It also includes some extra turns cards to maintain tempo and close out games quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a variety of spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage through draw spells like Consider and Treasure Cruise. Fiery Impulse and Spikefield Hazard provide removal options, while Spell Pierce helps to protect your own spells. Crackling Drake serves as a finisher, getting stronger with each instant or sorcery in your graveyard. The mana base is set up to consistently cast your spells with a mix of lands and Hall of Storm Giants for late-game power.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to cast powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator can be used to fetch important artifacts, while Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provides card draw and mana acceleration. Storm the Festival helps to dig for key creatures, and Lair of the Hydra can provide a big threat. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient green creatures and powerful spells.

The core strategy of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Monastery Swiftspear, and Pia Nalaar, Consul of Revival, the deck aims to deal damage rapidly while also removing threats with cards like Chained to the Rocks and Play with Fire. Showdown of the Skalds can provide a massive burst of damage and card advantage, allowing the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent. This deck prioritizes aggression and efficiency to secure victories in a fast-paced Pioneer format.

The main idea behind this UW Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan using counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the battlefield through cards like Absorb, Censor, and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria while also having a win condition in Shark Typhoon. The deck utilizes cards like Field of Ruin and Memory Deluge for mana fixing and card advantage, while also having access to additional control tools like Settle the Wreckage and Supreme Verdict. Overall, the deck focuses on outlasting the opponent and taking control of the game.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy using Azorius tempo cards and Spirits to control the game. By playing evasive creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom, along with disruptive cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to tempo out opponents while dealing damage with small creatures backed up by Curious Obsession. The inclusion of control elements like Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare helps to protect the board. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly while maintaining a level of control through tempo plays and creature disruption.

This deck focuses on controlling the battlefield and outlasting opponents by using a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and card draw. It also utilizes the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad to take advantage of its ability to flicker permanents for value. The deck contains a variety of win conditions, including Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Shark Typhoon, and powerful enchantments like March of Otherworldly Light. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and resilient threats, this UW Control deck aims to maintain board presence while slowly grinding down opponents to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling and utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which involves using Parhelion II alongside Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create a powerful and resilient board presence. The deck includes cards to help dig for combo pieces, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and protect the combo once assembled. Additionally, the deck includes versatile threats like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to apply pressure and control the board. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The deck revolves around assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, using cards like Grisly Salvage, Thoughtseize, and Vessel of Nascency to find key pieces. It also utilizes cards like Liliana of the Veil and Witherbloom Command for control and disruption. The deck aims to ramp into powerful threats like Parhelion II and utilize Greasefang, Okiba Boss to generate advantage. With a mix of card advantage, disruption, and combo potential, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost aggressive creatures, specifically white creatures. It aims to swarm the board with small creatures and overwhelm the opponent with their numbers. It utilizes cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to buff the entire team and make them stronger. It also includes cards like Brave the Elements and Ossification to provide protection and resilience to the creatures. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale to provide extra value and options for the player. Overall, the key concept is to win through aggressive and efficient creature-based strategies.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage provided by cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, while generating value through lands like Castle Ardenvale and Castle Vantress. The inclusion of cards like March of Otherworldly Light and The Wandering Emperor provide additional win conditions, while cards like Absorb and Dovin's Veto help protect the player's board state. Overall, the deck excels at controlling the pace of the game and outvaluing the opponent.

This Goblin Aggro deck focuses on quickly equipping Colossus Hammer to your creatures, boosting their power significantly. Sigarda's Aid and Resolute Strike help ensure your creatures can attack right away, while cards like Battle Cry Goblin and Legion Loyalist provide additional boosts. The deck also includes some token generators like Goblin Instigator and Skirk Prospector to swarm the board quickly. The mana base is optimized for a fast and aggressive start, with cards like Mana Confluence and dual lands to ensure you have the right colors of mana available.
